component: Thunderbird MOTS metadata and generated docs

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The YAML stores group URLs and review_group names separately, and the Markdown export renders separate Group and Review Group rows. Import also uses the explicit nobody owner alias, producing a Nobody row instead of an absent-owner warning. These data fields describe scoped roles; the placeholder is not a newly assigned person and the stored review group is not proof of automatic enforcement.
title: Ownership metadata keeps communication groups separate from review groups
